text_block_list.text:
Wh... what, what?! Whaaat?! What in the 
world was that just now...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It feels like power is surging from deep 
within my body... C-Could it be that the 
Three Goddesses really...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Ngh. Maybe it's just my imagination... 
But! I won't let it go to waste... not 
ever!"
